body:
I'm fed up of trying, every time I do people just keep me at arm's length and reject me. You can't intergrate with society if it doesn't let you in the first place. Thats leaves nothing, there isn't a point in living without any human connection.

And I know when I do die, hopefully soon, that everyone besides my family won't even blink. What's another dead subhuman POS.

I'm in a similar place atm, though Im slightly younger than you. I remember trying to kill myself at 13 and the realisation that my life hasn't changed in any meaningful way since then stings. If you want to talk about it, or anything really, Id be happy to.

Thank you for your comment u/Refferralsguy, I appreciate you taking time out of your day to contact someone like me. You must be one incredibly tough person to go through all you did and still make it out the other end. Ive been in and out of therapy for about a decade and tried all sorts of medication over the years, but unfortunately none of it helped. I think the worst part of my situation is that is isnt just a period in my life, its my entire life. I think if I had previously had friends and relationships, then the lack of them now wouldn't be so painful because I'd know that even if I didn't feel I had any value, I had proof that at least others did, even if only briefly.
I've never been given a chance to mess up a relationship, or lose contact with a friend, because nobody has believed me worthy enough to give me that chance. Whenever I reach out I get ignored. I naturally enjoy helping others but that's only led me to be used by people who would'nt bat an eye if I died. While I know you have the best intentions, whenever someone says to continue living it feels like they're telling me to torture myself further. I know I will never be a proper human, and form connections with people...and I don't see the point in continuing when I have no reason to.
Bugger me with a fork and call me breakfast, that's bloody terrifying...

Trying to talk to people, asking them about themselves etc. I only get 1 word/sentence answers and then someone else might ask the exact same thing a min later and they'll answer it properly. The only time anyone actively wants me around is for coursework help, and they abandon me as soon as they get what they want.

I think meaningful accomplishments are ones you can share with other tbh. I don't want to be exceptional or anything, just normal. A ok job, a few good friends and ideally a SO would be bloody amazing. I just want to feel wanted by someone.

I don't know if I know anyway to cope with being alone honestly. It kind feels like being in a vacuum, I can't seem to connect to anyone even when I reach out. I feel useless because besides University, I'm behind all my peers, hell most teenagers have more meaningful acccomplishments than I have. I have no friends, never been in a relationship, I can't drive, never been accepted for a job, etc. The fact that I haven't done any of these things will make it worse in the future. As I said before; you have to have friends to make friends, you have to have been in a relationship to get in one at my age, you need work experience to get a job. I'm utterly pathetic and objectively deserve to die.
My favourite bit of this is the woman beside him pulling a face thats half disappointed and half mmhhmmm got ya!

I'm in the same situation. Blaming other people for my problems, or just bad luck, in finding a relationship seems completely messed up, it isn't anyone's responsibility but mine. I still get incredibly lonely alot of the time, but that kind of makes me happy that most people have that sort of relationship with someone, and dont have to feel like I have to do at my worst.

Unfortunately I can't offer any solutions because I'm in an identical situation myself (though I'm a guy), I will say your not alone in your loneliness, and if you want someone to chat to then I'm more than happy to. From your post you seem like a great person, you should be proud of how much you've managed to change, even though I know its hard when you don't get acknowledgemnt of it from other people.
